notes: Durable monitoring priors, discovery sources, applicant profile, funding-policy constants, and application-timing rules for a public repository. Known opportunities are monitored through state; discovery sources find additional opportunities. Current official pages override stale metadata when a recheck occurs.

yale_funding_policy.policy_name: External Fellowships and Combined Award Policy

application_timing_policy.rule: If any required third-party recommendation/support/nomination action applies, set the action date at least 2 calendar months before the operative deadline. This overrides any shorter roster or generic lead time; use a longer lead if verified current-cycle requirements warrant it.

opportunities.name: Yale Economics Graduate Student Research Support
opportunities.eligibility_note: Yale Economics PhD students; verify remaining personal caps before use.
opportunities.monitor_note: Baseline substitute when judging the incremental value of external research/data support. Current policy provides up to $3,000 total for data acquisition while enrolled.

opportunities.name: ISPS Research Funding
opportunities.sponsor: Yale Institution for Social and Policy Studies
opportunities.eligibility_note: Yale graduate students are eligible for relevant research funds; verify fund-specific fit.
opportunities.monitor_note: High-value internal source, including High-Value Datasets, Government Effectiveness, Democratic Innovations, and Survey Research Methodology funds.

opportunities.name: Horowitz Foundation for Social Policy Grant
opportunities.eligibility_note: Current PhD/DrPH candidate working on dissertation with proposal defended or topic approved. Beginning in 2023, applicants may not apply more than once.
opportunities.monitor_note: Classify Yale treatment before assigning value: the sponsor pays individuals, but additive value depends on whether Yale treats the award as stipend or non-stipend support.

opportunities.name: National Institute of Social Sciences Dissertation Grant
opportunities.usual_timing: spring; do not assume recurrence until a new official cycle appears
opportunities.eligibility_note: Economics is an eligible discipline in the 2026 call. University provost or designated officer must submit the nomination.
opportunities.monitor_note: Use this stable grants page to discover the current cycle. The operative deadline is Yale's internal nomination deadline if one exists, not merely the sponsor deadline.

opportunities.name: Hsiao Memorial Social Sciences Scholarship
opportunities.eligibility_note: Graduate social-science students at U.S. institutions; financial need and sponsor-specific preferences apply.
opportunities.monitor_note: Keep in roster but surface only when current-cycle eligibility and application burden make it worthwhile.

opportunities.name: ACES Dissertation Research Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_note: PhD students working in comparative economics and related areas; verify current call terms when posted.
opportunities.monitor_note: Potentially strong political-economy fit, but assign teaching-relief value only after current award terms and Yale treatment are clear.

opportunities.name: NSF Economics Doctoral Dissertation Research Improvement Grant
opportunities.usual_timing: do not infer; follow current NSF publication
opportunities.eligibility_note: Faculty-submitted on behalf of doctoral student; supports research expenses rather than stipend or tuition.
opportunities.monitor_note: Do not resurface weekly while dormant. Recheck on state schedule or when a new NSF publication is discovered.

opportunities.name: NBER Fiscal and Economic Effects of Innovation and Productivity Fellowship
opportunities.eligibility_note: Historical fellowship; do not infer a new cycle.
opportunities.monitor_note: Do not resurface this specific fellowship. Continue monitoring NBER for different rotating fellowship topics.

discovery_sources.instruction: High-yield Yale discovery pages. Known rostered programs are monitored through state, not rescanned here. Surface only opportunities for which the Economics PhD applicant is actually eligible.

pages.name: NBER Calls for Papers and Proposals
Washington Center for Equitable Growth Funding Opportunities

discovery_sources.instruction: Use for high-fit new calls or valuable data/access opportunities. Current eligibility and deadline claims must come from the sponsor page for the specific opportunity.
Discovery only. Do not assume Yale Economics eligibility from inclusion in a YSE database; verify every surfaced candidate with the sponsor.
Run only on the first Monday of January, April, July, and October unless targeted evidence justifies an earlier check. These broad pages are discovery seeds, not proof that a current call is open.
